analysis: A2-A1 task-level mean of two session outcomes; task-cluster percentile bootstrap, 9999 resamples, fixed seed9999; few-cluster limitations retained; A0 and first/final contrasts secondary

budget_pilot.selection_basis: 9 supported tasks, 2 independent sessions per arm; total fixed-wall ceiling 3.6 hours plus heldout scoring fits the authorized study window with integration reserve; no confirmatory outcomes inspected

disturbance_assumptions: explicit +/-5% modeled robot mass/damping and +/-10% contact-friction multipliers; engineering assumptions, not calibrated physical uncertainties
endpoint: selected artifact satisfies the same frozen eligible geometry checks and all five heldout physics cases within unchanged task, actuator and observation-window constraints
family_grouping: near-duplicate family templates share structural lineage; nine task clusters do not represent nine independently invented robot morphologies
gantry_geometry_scope: fixed sourced-drive geometry is not recomputed by E1 geometry gates because timing is the only admitted candidate variable and its geometry endpoint is empty; full common CAD inspection and unchanged task/actuator physics remain available
outcomes: PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/CRASH all retained in planned episode denominator; no build-valid candidate is FAIL, unavailable evaluator observation UNKNOWN, execution loss CRASH
primary_contrast: A2 minus A1 task-success fraction, paired at task level
provider_context_configuration_status: CLI configuration prescribed identically across arms; acceptance pending actual pilot
provider_request_limits: same runtime/model configuration and hard wall ceiling for all arms; actual token usage retained separately; no hard aggregate paid-token budget
selection: last task-preserving build-valid candidate with a completed trusted artifact receipt before episode closure; no hidden-score selection
separation: candidate sees only selected workspace, CAD and projected feedback; private source/evaluator/heldout files absent from namespace; forge maintainer is trusted and can inspect private study inputs
